jan_recommendation: Pleasant winter weather and clear skies, perfect for seaside walks and sightseeing!
feb_recommendation: Dry and comfortable winter days, ideal for exploring markets and heritage sites.
mar_recommendation: Warm and sunny start to summer, enjoy outdoor plans but carry sunscreen and water.
apr_recommendation: Warm and humid summer days, wear breathable clothes and stay hydrated.
may_recommendation: Hot and very humid before the monsoon, plan outdoor time for early mornings.
jun_recommendation: Monsoon arrives with very heavy rain, carry an umbrella and expect travel delays.
jul_recommendation: Peak monsoon with extremely heavy rain and waterlogging, prefer indoor activities and check local transport updates.
aug_recommendation: Heavy monsoon showers continue, waterproof footwear and an umbrella are a must.
sep_recommendation: Monsoon rains are easing but still frequent, keep an umbrella and flexible plans.
oct_recommendation: Post monsoon heat returns with humid days, stay hydrated and enjoy evening outings.
nov_recommendation: Warm and mostly dry post monsoon weather, great for sightseeing and beach evenings!
dec_recommendation: Pleasant winter weather with clear skies, perfect for outdoor sightseeing!
